sn5.1:1.1: This chapter naturally follows the previous, as it features Māra challenging various bhikhhunīs. Most of these verses are also included in the Therīgāthā.
sn5.1:1.4: Normally one goes “for the day’s meditation” (_divāvihārāya_), whereas here, uniquely, the text has “seeking seclusion” (_vivekatthinī_).
sn5.1:4.4: More idiomatically: you don’t know what you’re talking about.
